name: Another Boring Piece
author: John Schmidt
description: Hand-picked fine art from anotherboring.day as your Omarchy background, with optional rotation on a schedule.

barWidget.description: Today's piece plus two more, set as your background in a click.

schema.label: Rotate automatically
schema.description: Pick a fresh piece on a schedule while the shell is running.

schema.label: Rotation interval (seconds)
schema.description: The panel cycles through 1, 3, 12 and 24 hours (3600, 10800, 43200, 86400). Any other value in range is honoured and shown as itself; cycling from it lands on the nearest preset.

schema.label: Rotate to
schema.description: "random" sets a random piece every interval. "today" follows the daily release instead: shortly after midnight UTC the new piece is set, and the interval is ignored. A piece set by hand after the release stays until the next one.

schema.label: Notify on change
schema.description: Send a notification naming the piece each time the background changes.

schema.label: Theme extraction mode
schema.description: How aether reads a palette out of the artwork when you build a theme from it. "normal" is the default: aether decides between a monochrome and a chromatic palette by analysing the image. The rest force a treatment, such as "pastel" for a soft, low-chroma reading of the piece. Unrecognised values fall back to "normal".

schema.label: Build light themes
schema.description: Build the light variant of the palette instead of the dark one. Only affects themes built from a piece.
